transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. I, um... I hope it's okay that I'm here. It's probably just my mind playing tricks on me, you know, just stress or something. 

But... well, I've been hearing some things. Just... voices, I guess? I know how bad that sounds, and I'm really sorry to bother you with it. I promise I'm not trying to make a big fuss. But when I'm home in my little studio, and the house is completely quiet... I hear them clear as day, like somebody is standing right next to me. They say my name, and they keep telling me my work is being judged. But there's nobody there at all. 

Is... is it okay that I came in for that? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it right and doing the right thing.
How long have you been hearing these voices?

Oh, um... I guess it's been a little while. I'm so sorry I didn't come in sooner, I really didn't want to be a bother to anyone or make a big deal out of nothing. 

I'd say it's been... about nine months now? That I've been hearing them, I mean. And along with the voices, I've just had this... this awful, fixed fear that my work is being watched all the time. I know how crazy that sounds, and I try so hard to just ignore it and do a good job anyway. 

I hope it's okay that I waited this long to say anything... I just didn't want you to think badly of me. Did I answer your question okay?
During these past nine months, how has your mood been feeling overall?

My mood? Oh, um... well, I hope this doesn't make me sound awful. I try so hard to be a good person, especially for the folks I look after at work. 

It's just been a little... up and down, I suppose? Sometimes I feel just so... bright and chosen, if that makes sense. Like I have all these wonderful ideas and the whole town of Greenville just can't even hold all my plans. It's actually a really nice feeling, I hope it's alright that I get like that. 

But then... and I'm so embarrassed to admit this to you... sometimes I get really short. I'll go from feeling just on top of the world to... well, to snapping hard at someone over the littlest thing. Like, if one of my clients just asks me to repeat myself, I'll just snap at them. I always feel so guilty right after, because I know they can't help it, and I promise you I'm really not a mean person at heart. 

Am I explaining that okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Have there been times over these past nine months when you heard the voices or felt watched, even when your mood felt completely normal?

Oh, um... yes. I hope it's okay that I tell you this, I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining or... or just totally losing my mind. But, yes. 

There was a time when all that big energy I told you about kind of dropped off, and I was finally sleeping more normally again. I thought, you know, maybe everything was just going to be fine and dandy and I could just get back to being a good aide. But... and I'm so sorry, I know I should have been completely better... the voices just kept right on going. And that awful belief that people were tracking my work and judging me... it stayed with me for several weeks, even when my mood felt completely regular and fine. 

I hope that's the right answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the pieces you need to help me, if that makes sense.
